policies.title: Calculation rules & limitations
policies.description: Review the basis and limits behind your demo flight estimates.
policies.source: These details come from a backend estimate response. When needed, this page retrieves them using the demo itinerary; that request does not become your flight simulation.
policies.methodology: How the demo estimate is produced
policies.segmentMethod: The backend assigns {points} demo LSP to each manually eligible segment whose origin and destination are both in the scope below.
policies.totalMethod: The backend adds the known segment estimates. If any segment is unresolved, both the total LSP and cost per LSP remain pending.
policies.costMethod: For a positive total LSP, cost per point is the full itinerary airfare divided by that total. The interface rounds the returned cost to the nearest yen for display.
policies.scope: Airports in the current demo scope
policies.scopeHint: This limited list is supplied by the backend policy. It is not a complete airport registry, and a route alone never verifies eligibility.
policies.manualLimit: Eligibility is entered manually. The project does not verify tickets, booking classes or actual point entitlement with JAL.
policies.unknownLimit: Unknown eligibility and eligible routes outside the demo scope produce unresolved estimates. They are not treated as zero points.
policies.zeroLimit: A manually ineligible segment receives zero demo LSP. If the total is zero, cost per point is unavailable. Zero airfare is accepted.
policies.carrierLimit: Dates and marketing carriers are retained in the breakdown. This demo has no date-specific or carrier-specific calculation rules.
policies.balanceLimit: Simulations do not change your current LSP balance. Your personal target is a planning value, not a verified JGC qualification assessment.

policy.title: Built for planning. Awaiting policy verification.
policy.description: All flight calculations are unverified demo estimates, not confirmed JAL entitlements. Eligibility is entered manually. Life Status Points (LSP) are separate from annual FLY ON Points.
